name: ^new ClientError$
reason: Constructs the error the twin then throws; the trace checks the exact message.

name: ^parseOr$
reason: Library schema parse; the trace checks the classified error and the twin reads the fields back.

name: ^Sandbox\.get$
reason: Vercel SDK lookup; the trace checks name and auth, and the twin reads only recorded fields.

name: ^sandbox\.(delete|snapshot)$
reason: Vercel SDK verb on the sandbox just looked up; the twin reads the recorded status.

name: ^new (Terminate|Get|CreateMicrovmAuthToken)MicrovmCommand$
reason: AWS SDK command constructors; the trace checks the exact input and the token goes only to send.

name: ^new CreateMicrovmAuthTokenCommand$
reason: AWS SDK command constructor; the trace checks the exact input and the token goes only to send.

name: ^this\.#client( \.|\.)send$
reason: AWS Lambda MicroVM transport; the trace checks which command token is sent.

name: ^new AwsS3Client$
reason: AWS SDK constructor; the trace checks the region and the client is returned unchanged.

name: ^q$
reason: Local alias of shellQuote whose answer is checked against the exact command.

name: ^this\.#executor\.(exec|suspend|release)$
reason: Harness transport or executor verb; the trace checks the exact command or reservation key.

name: ^this\.#proxy\.close$
reason: Proxy teardown with no answer used.

name: ^HarnessShellProcess\.start$
reason: Starts the guest process; the trace checks the whole start request and the handle is returned unchanged.

name: ^Date\.now$
reason: Host clock, used only as a cache timestamp passed on.

name: ^response\.json$
reason: Worker response body; the twin hands it to the schema parse.

name: ^statusResult\.parse$
reason: Schema parse of the worker status; the trace checks the body.

name: ^mapMicrovmState$
reason: Enum map whose input the trace checks; its answer is returned unchanged.

name: apps/core/src/harness/sandbox/microvm-executor.ts#evictToCap

name: S3Client
reason: AWS client token returned unchanged.

name: ReadableStream
reason: Stream token passed through unchanged.

name: ^(parseInput|disabledFeature)$
reason: Schema parse and a one-line flag read; the trace checks the input and the twin reads back the answer.

name: ^options\.abortSignal\?\.throwIfAborted$
reason: Host abort signal; an abort reaches the twin as this effect's throw.

name: ^this\.#executor( \.|\.)(acquireHarnessReservation|resumeHarnessReservation|release)$
reason: Reservation verbs on the injected executor; the trace checks the full request.

name: ^new MicrovmHarnessSession$
reason: Session constructor; the trace checks the complete options and the handle is passed on unchanged.

name: ^(readS3Text|readS3Bytes|listS3Prefix|s3ObjectExists|isMissingS3Error)$
reason: S3 helpers; the trace checks bucket, key and access and the twin uses the recorded answer.

name: ^new Bun\.Glob$
reason: Glob compiler; the trace checks the pattern.

name: ^matcher\.match$
reason: Glob match; the trace checks each candidate and the twin only filters on the answer.

name: ^(getHarnessPublicUrl|requireSecretsEnv|sealMediaTicket)$
reason: Configuration and ticket sealing; the trace checks the sealed payload and secret.

name: ^executor \.run$
reason: Sandbox provider run; the trace checks the whole request and the result is returned unchanged.

reason: Traced helper or formatter; the trace checks the arguments.

name: ^(resolveWorkspace|workspaceAttachment|channelAttachmentName|contentTypeForPath|toolError|toolText)$
reason: Tool helpers; the trace checks their inputs and passes their answers through.

name: ^(sandboxConfigs|deleteSandboxInstance|claimSandboxInstance|removeSandboxInstance|releaseOnProvider)$
reason: Persistence and provider release; the trace checks each call and its args.
